old_requirement: Fictional rule: The company must acknowledge receipt of a customer complaint within five business days. Complaint resolution remains a separate process.
new_requirement: Fictional rule: The company must acknowledge receipt of a customer complaint within two business days. Complaint resolution remains a separate process.

documents.title: Procedure A — earlier acknowledgement process
documents.text: Acknowledge receipt of a customer complaint within five business days.

documents.title: Procedure B — updated acknowledgement process
documents.text: Acknowledge receipt of a customer complaint within two business days.

documents.title: Complaint resolution procedure
documents.text: Resolve customer complaints within 30 calendar days.
